body.name: Full-history weak-shadow compatible-law fiber
body.construction:
\[
\mathcal K(p)=\left\{q\in\Delta(\Omega):
\begin{array}{ll}
O_\#q=p, & \\
q_t^F(h,a)=\mu_t(a\mid O_t(h))\displaystyle\sum_{a'\in\mathcal A}q_t^F(h,a')
&\forall (t,h,a)\in\mathcal T\times\mathcal H_t^F\times\mathcal A,\\
q_t(h,a,r,1,s)q_t(h,a,r,0,s')
=q_t(h,a,r,0,s)q_t(h,a,r,1,s')
&\forall (t,h,a,r,s,s')\in
\mathcal T\times\mathcal H_t^F\times\mathcal A\times\mathcal R\times\mathcal S^2
\end{array}
\right\}.
\]
Here \(O_t:\mathcal H_t^F\to\mathcal H_t^O\) is the history-level restriction of the coarsening map \(O\).
